findings.summary: Prettier split the queue's refresh-failed banner text into two adjacent text nodes with the same visible text, and no test pins that DOM shape.
make frontend-format rewrites three markdown files that ESLint does not read on every run, so each run needs a git restore of them before a commit.
The react-refresh/only-export-components warning for buttonVariants in src/components/ui/button.tsx is left in place, since moving the export is not a layout change.
